svg.title: Workflow Control: a Built-in Key for Each Problem
svg.desc: Four built-in keys solve four problems: concurrency queues or cancels overlapping runs, timeout-minutes ends hung jobs, a matrix fans one job across operating systems and versions, and outputs pass values to dependent jobs.
svg.text: Workflow Control: a Built-in Key for Each Problem
Reach for the native key before writing glue code.
Queue deploys; cancel-in-progress for PR CI
A hung job holds a runner
Job or step level (default 360); none at workflow level
Same job on every OS and version
One definition fans out; max-parallel limits it
A later job needs a value
Set via $GITHUB_OUTPUT; jobs don't share a
A trigger filter would stop every job
